summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. work.py is pure numba structref/intrinsic code with no @cfunc/C-ABI boundary, no raw unaligned pointer access, and no symbol resolution, so the cfunc-exception-swallow, struct-by-value-ABI, align-1, and cache=True hunts do not apply. The NRT refcount discipline across all generated kernels (_calculate_/_loader_/_combine_/_inputs_vector_) and the supporting intrinsics (_get_source_N, _call_derive, _cast_to_work_data, as_node) is balanced: borrowed values are incref'd exactly when promoted to owned locals or stored into a struct field, and numba's auto-decref of locals plus struct-setattr decref-of-old close every path including the early returns.
